description.sub_name: 數位行銷程式設計基礎
description.describe_ch: 「數位行銷」是透過電腦或網路進行的行銷方式，實務應用上需要行銷理論及數位技術共同配合。本課程教導數位行銷所需之基本網頁設計技術、資訊處理程式實作，引導學生能夠學習數位行銷基本的實作技巧。
description.describe_eh: "Digital marketing" is a marketing method carried out through computers or the Internet. The practical application requires the cooperation of marketing theory and digital technology. This course teaches the basic web design technology and information processing program implementation required by digital marketing, and guides students to learn the basic practical skills of digital marketing.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. RWD/AWD 網頁設計評分：
    1. 每週均有課堂作業，課堂作業基本評分方式：課堂內完整內容繳交>=80分(三天內更完善補交加分)，除特殊情況外，其餘時間交付<80分，隔週後交付<=60分，缺交0分。分數比例為30%。
    2. 專題一：建立一RWD基本網頁，需用到HTML、CSS、JavaScript(選項)語法，可於手持裝置展示RWD功能，分數比例為10%。
  2. Python程式設計評分：
    1. 每週均有課堂作業，課堂作業基本評分方式：課堂內完整內容繳交>=80分(可三天內更完善補交加分)，其餘時間交付<80分，隔週後交付<=60分，缺交0分。分數比例為30%。
    2. 專題二：應用爬蟲範例抓取並整理成圖表顯示，主題及內容於課堂說明。僅需書面報告及程式展示，遲交0分。分數比例為10%。
  3. 點名及課堂表現評分：
    1. 從第一週起每週點名，共計14週，占10%，全勤同學總分另加5分（由課堂教學內容上傳小組作業認定，若未到者小組登記有到，則當週全組成員小組作業0分）。
    2. 期中前超過4次未到即發期中預警。
    3. 於iLearn互動內容以行為機制自動演算分數，占10%。
    4. 其餘課堂良好表現，斟酌加分於總分。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
RWD/AWD Web Design Grading:
  • Weekly in-class assignments. The basic grading method for assignments is as follows:
    • Submit complete work during class ≥80 points (Additional points for resubmission within three days).
    • Submissions after the specified time <80 points.
    • Submissions after the next week ≤60 points.
    • Missing assignments will receive 0 points.
    • The weight of this component is 30%.
Project 1:
  • Create a basic RWD webpage using HTML, CSS, and optionally JavaScript. The webpage should be able to display RWD functionality on mobile devices.
  • The weight of this component is 10%.
Python Programming Grading:
  • Weekly in-class assignments. The basic grading method for assignments is the same as for web design, with a 30% weight.
Project 2:
  • Use a web scraping example to gather data and present it in a chart. Details of the topic and content will be explained in class.
  • Only a written report and program demonstration are required. Late submissions will receive 0 points.
  • The weight of this component is 10%.
Attendance and Classroom Performance Grading:
  • Attendance will be taken weekly from the first week, totaling 14 weeks. This component accounts for 10% of the grade.
  • Perfect attendance (excluding official leave and special circumstances) will result in an additional 5 points.
  • A warning will be issued if there are more than 4 absences before the midterm.
  • Interaction content on iLearn will be automatically scored based on behavior mechanisms, accounting for 10%.
  • Good classroom performance will be considered for additional points to the total score.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. 本課程每節點名，遲到十五分鐘視同缺課，若無特殊理由期中前缺課超過8節以上(實體上課四週)通知預警，本門課程嚴格執行。
2. 有意願加選同學，第一週請務必到課，不接受第一堂未到要加選的同學（超過座位人數即不能加選，請隔年再修) ，本條件嚴格執行，大三、大四同學請特別注意。
3. 任一專案未在規定期限內交付，視同不及格。
4. 協助點名代簽同學及請求代簽同學，兩者均依考試作弊方式處理。
5. 點名簽名完無故離席同學，計為三堂課不到，該節所有作業、專案成績0分計算。
6. 不含請假及特殊原因，缺課12節以上，照行銷系規定，視同不及格，本學期嚴格執行。
7. 因電腦教室座位有限，每班能授課的人數，依電腦教室座位數規定，不另行增加名額。
8. 上課擾亂秩序同學將請離開教室，並記錄三堂未到。
9. 期中前包含請假超過4次未到即發期中預警。
10. 遲到同學，請坐在離入門口最近的一列座位（第一節課會說明）。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Attendance will be taken in every class. Students who are more than 15 minutes late will be considered absent. If a student misses more than 8 classes (equivalent to four weeks of in-person sessions) before midterm without a valid reason, a warning will be issued. This rule will be strictly enforced.
2. Students wishing to add the course must attend the first class. Students who fail to attend the first class will not be allowed to add the course, and if the number of students exceeds the available seats, they will not be able to join. This rule will be strictly enforced, especially for third-year and fourth-year students.
3. Any project not submitted by the specified deadline will be considered as not passing.
4. Students who assist in signing in for others or request someone else to sign in for them will be treated as engaging in academic dishonesty, similar to cheating during exams.
5. If a student leaves the class without reason after signing the attendance, it will count as missing three classes, and all assignments and project grades for that class will be calculated as zero.
6. Students who miss more than 12 classes without approved leave or special reasons will be considered as failing according to the department's rules. This rule will be strictly enforced this semester.
7. Due to limited seating in the computer classroom, the number of students in each class is fixed according to the available seats. No additional students will be accepted.
8. Students who disturb the class will be asked to leave the classroom and will be recorded as having missed three classes.
9. If a student misses more than 4 classes, including excused absences, before midterm, a midterm warning will be issued.
10. Late students should sit in the row nearest the entrance (this will be explained during the first class).
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:

1. This course is part of the university's new digital learning curriculum. Some sessions will include online self-learning content and be taught through online methods. The course plan will be dynamically adjusted based on students' learning progress.
2. This course is a required professional course for the Marketing Department. Students from other departments should inquire whether this course counts toward their department's graduation credits before enrolling.
3. The topics for Project 1 and Project 2 are aligned with the theme of the film exhibition project.
4. This course does not allow or approve absences to shoot for the film exhibition project.
5. Students are welcome to bring their own laptops to class.
6. The grading method and class rules will be explained during the first class. Please review the materials in advance and feel free to ask any questions during class. Due to the tight course schedule, no further public explanations will be made afterward. For students adding the course, if they are late or absent on the first day, the course add/drop policy will be strictly enforced, and they will not be allowed to add the course.
7. This course will be adjusted in sync with the progress of the film exhibition. Please make sure to attend the first class to understand the related rules and requirements.

    1. 從第一週起每週點名，共計14週，占10%，全勤同學總分另加5分（由課堂教學內容上傳小組作業認定，若未到者小組登記有到，則當週全組成員小組作業0分）。

integrity.tpa_score_new_en:
RWD/AWD Web Design Grading:
  • Weekly in-class assignments. The basic grading method for assignments is as follows:
    • Submit complete work during class ≥80 points (Additional points for resubmission within three days).
    • Submissions after the specified time <80 points.
    • Submissions after the next week ≤60 points.
    • Missing assignments will receive 0 points.
    • The weight of this component is 30%.
Project 1:
  • Create a basic RWD webpage using HTML, CSS, and optionally JavaScript. The webpage should be able to display RWD functionality on mobile devices.
  • The weight of this component is 10%.

  • Weekly in-class assignments. The basic grading method for assignments is the same as for web design, with a 30% weight.

  • Only a written report and program demonstration are required. Late submissions will receive 0 points.

  • Attendance will be taken weekly from the first week, totaling 14 weeks. This component accounts for 10% of the grade.

  • Interaction content on iLearn will be automatically scored based on behavior mechanisms, accounting for 10%.
  • Good classroom performance will be considered for additional points to the total score.

1. 本課程每節點名，遲到十五分鐘視同缺課，若無特殊理由期中前缺課超過8節以上(實體上課四週)通知預警，本門課程嚴格執行。

6. 不含請假及特殊原因，缺課12節以上，照行銷系規定，視同不及格，本學期嚴格執行。

9. 期中前包含請假超過4次未到即發期中預警。
10. 遲到同學，請坐在離入門口最近的一列座位（第一節課會說明）。
integrity.course_pol_en:
Attendance will be taken in every class. Students who are more than 15 minutes late will be considered absent. If a student misses more than 8 classes (equivalent to four weeks of in-person sessions) before midterm without a valid reason, a warning will be issued. This rule will be strictly enforced.
2. Students wishing to add the course must attend the first class. Students who fail to attend the first class will not be allowed to add the course, and if the number of students exceeds the available seats, they will not be able to join. This rule will be strictly enforced, especially for third-year and fourth-year students.
3. Any project not submitted by the specified deadline will be considered as not passing.
4. Students who assist in signing in for others or request someone else to sign in for them will be treated as engaging in academic dishonesty, similar to cheating during exams.
5. If a student leaves the class without reason after signing the attendance, it will count as missing three classes, and all assignments and project grades for that class will be calculated as zero.
6. Students who miss more than 12 classes without approved leave or special reasons will be considered as failing according to the department's rules. This rule will be strictly enforced this semester.
7. Due to limited seating in the computer classroom, the number of students in each class is fixed according to the available seats. No additional students will be accepted.
8. Students who disturb the class will be asked to leave the classroom and will be recorded as having missed three classes.
9. If a student misses more than 4 classes, including excused absences, before midterm, a midterm warning will be issued.
10. Late students should sit in the row nearest the entrance (this will be explained during the first class).
integrity.course_rem:
1. 本課程列為學校新制數位學習課程，部分課程會包含線上自我學習課程內容、線上授課方式教授，課程規劃依照學生學習狀況滾動式調整。
2. 本課程為行銷系的專業必修課程，外系同學請先詢問本課程是否有納入貴系畢業學分後再行選課。
3. 本課程專題一、二為配合影展專題主題訂立。
4. 本課程不允許也不同意因影展專題需要拍攝之理由請假。
5. 可自帶電腦上課。
6. 本課程於第一堂課講解課程計分方式、上課規則說明，請同學先行參閱後可於課堂內提出問題，之後因課程內容緊湊，不再另行公開說明。加選同學，第一堂課遲到、未到者，嚴格執行不予以加選。以上請特別注意。
7. 本課程將搭配影展進度進行滾動式調整課程內容，第一堂課請務必到課了解相關規定。
integrity.course_rem_en:
1. This course is part of the university's new digital learning curriculum. Some sessions will include online self-learning content and be taught through online methods. The course plan will be dynamically adjusted based on students' learning progress.
2. This course is a required professional course for the Marketing Department. Students from other departments should inquire whether this course counts toward their department's graduation credits before enrolling.
3. The topics for Project 1 and Project 2 are aligned with the theme of the film exhibition project.
4. This course does not allow or approve absences to shoot for the film exhibition project.
5. Students are welcome to bring their own laptops to class.
6. The grading method and class rules will be explained during the first class. Please review the materials in advance and feel free to ask any questions during class. Due to the tight course schedule, no further public explanations will be made afterward. For students adding the course, if they are late or absent on the first day, the course add/drop policy will be strictly enforced, and they will not be allowed to add the course.
7. This course will be adjusted in sync with the progress of the film exhibition. Please make sure to attend the first class to understand the related rules and requirements.
